That's fine — no need for shell verification since the Edit tool already confirmed the change applied cleanly.

I reviewed `0.html`, which was already a well-built, accessible pulsing-circle widget. The main real improvement I found: `restartAnimations()` was forcing 4 separate layout reflows (one `offsetWidth` read per animated element) every time the speed changed. I batched it into a single reflow, which reduces layout thrashing without changing behavior.

The rest of the file (accessibility labeling, reduced-motion handling, cross-tab sync, keyboard controls) is solid and I didn't see other correctness bugs worth changing. Let me know if you want me to focus on something specific — e.g., visual redesign, adding more speed presets, or performance profiling of the glow filter.
